3. Why the blocker is mathematically the right one
At a mathematical level, the gap is exactly the passage from pointwise/fibrewise information to a family
construction. Knowing that a line bundle has h0 = 1 and H1 = 0 after passing to fields is not, by itself,
enough to define the inverse Abel construction as a morphism on arbitrary test schemes.
   To construct a relative effective divisor canonically from a family of line bundles, the pushforward must
    behave as a rank-one locally free object on the relevant locus, not merely have one-dimensional fibres.
   The construction must commute with pullback. In Lean terms, the cartesian pushforward/base-change
    morphisms needed by the public API have to be IsIso in the precise hypotheses used by the family.
   The H0 rank-one statement and H1 vanishing must be tied to the same native presentation and
    transported coherently under arbitrary affine base change.
   Only then does the canonical section/evaluation divisor vary functorially and supply the inverse to the Abel
    map on the rank-one open locus.
   Consequently, a fieldwise translated-cover witness is a valid feeder, but it cannot replace the family-level
    representability/open-locus theorem. This is precisely why run 123 is correct to refuse that shortcut.

     9	# Canonical pushforward base change for scheme modules
    10	
    11	For a cartesian square of schemes, `canonicalBaseChangeMap` is the Beck--Chevalley mate
    12	
    13	```text
    14	g^* f_* M --> f'_* (g')^* M.
    15	```
    16	
    17	The two coherence theorems identify its pullback followed by the counit with the pullback of
    18	the original counit.  Invertibility is deliberately not asserted here: it is a property of the
    19	module and square, not part of the construction of the canonical map.
    20	-/
    21	
    22	set_option autoImplicit false
    23	
    24	universe u
    25	
    26	open CategoryTheory Limits
    27	
    28	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    29	
    30	/-- The canonical Beck--Chevalley mate for pushforward along a cartesian square. -/
    31	noncomputable def canonicalBaseChangeMap
    32	    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    33	    {f : X ⟶ S} {g : S' ⟶ S} {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ S'}
    34	    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) :
    35	    Scheme.Modules.pushforward f ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pullback g ⟶
    36	      Scheme.Modules.pullback g' ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pushforward f' :=
    37	  CategoryTheory.mateEquiv
    38	    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f)
    39	    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f')
    40	    (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f' g) ≪≫
    41	      Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr sq.w.symm ≪≫
    42	      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g' f).symm).hom)
    43	
    44	/-- Pulling back the canonical mate and evaluating recovers its defining pullback telescope. -/
    45	theorem canonicalBaseChangeMap_pullback_counit
    46	    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    47	    {f : X ⟶ S} {g : S' ⟶ S} {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ S'}
    48	    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) (M : X.Modules) :
    49	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback f').map ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app M) ≫
    50	        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f').counit.app
    51	          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj M) =
    52	      ((((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f' g) ≪≫
    53	        Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr sq.w.symm ≪≫
    54	        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g' f).symm).hom).app
    55	          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M)) ≫
    56	        (Scheme.Modules.pullback g').map
    57	          ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).counit.app M) := by
    58	  rw [canonicalBaseChangeMap]
    59	  exact CategoryTheory.mateEquiv_counit _ _ _ M
    60	
    61	/-- After cancelling the pullback telescope, the base-changed counit is the pulled-back
    62	original counit. -/
    63	theorem canonicalBaseChangeMap_counit_cancel
    64	    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    65	    {f : X ⟶ S} {g : S' ⟶ S} {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ S'}
    66	    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) (M : X.Modules) :
    67	    ((((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f' g) ≪≫
    68	      Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr sq.w.symm ≪≫
    69	      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g' f).symm).inv).app
    70	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M)) ≫
    71	      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f').map ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app M) ≫
    72	        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f').counit.app
    73	          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj M)) =
    74	      (Scheme.Modules.pullback g').map
    75	        ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).counit.app M) := by
    76	  erw [canonicalBaseChangeMap_pullback_counit]
    77	  erw [Iso.inv_hom_id_app_assoc]
    78	  rfl
    79	
    80	end AlgebraicGeometry

     9	import Mathlib.Topology.Sheaves.Stalks
    10	
    11	/-!
    12	# Affine locality for native pushforward base change
    13	
    14	This file supplies two generic reductions used when proving that a canonical base-change mate is
    15	an isomorphism.
    16	
    17	* `Scheme.Modules.isIso_of_isIso_app_affine` upgrades isomorphisms on every affine open to an
    18	  isomorphism of sheaves of modules.  It uses the affine-open basis and stalks, and does not impose
    19	  quasi-coherence or finiteness hypotheses.
    20	* The two `of_fromTildeΓ` lemmas upgrade an isomorphism, or a bijection, on global sections of
    21	  `Spec R` once the source and target affine presentations `fromTildeΓ` are already known to be
    22	  isomorphisms.
    23	
    24	The latter hypothesis is deliberately explicit.  The pinned Mathlib does not provide the general
    25	affine equivalence between quasi-coherent modules on `Spec R` and `R`-modules, so these lemmas do
    26	not assert that quasi-coherence alone constructs the two affine presentations.
    27	-/
    28	
    29	set_option autoImplicit false
    30	
    31	universe u
    32	
    33	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace
    34	
    35	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    36	
    37	open Scheme Scheme.Modules
    38	
    39	-- The composite defining `e.hom` unfolds only below reducible transparency.
    40	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
    41	/-- A morphism between two modules on `Spec R` with known affine presentations is an isomorphism
    42	as soon as its map on the corresponding global-sections modules is an isomorphism. -/
    43	theorem Scheme.Modules.isIso_of_isIso_moduleSpecGammaFunctor_map_of_fromTildeGamma
    44	    {R : CommRingCat.{u}} {M N : (Spec R).Modules}
    45	    [IsIso M.fromTildeΓ] [IsIso N.fromTildeΓ] (φ : M ⟶ N)
    46	    (h : IsIso ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := R)).map φ)) : IsIso φ := by
    47	  have key : M.fromTildeΓ ≫ φ =
    48	      (tilde.functor R).map ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := R)).map φ) ≫ N.fromTildeΓ :=
    49	    ((Scheme.Modules.fromTildeΓNatTrans (R := R)).naturality φ).symm
    50	  let iM := asIso M.fromTildeΓ
    51	  let iN := asIso N.fromTildeΓ
    52	  let iG := @asIso _ _ _ _ ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := R)).map φ) h
    53	  let e : M ≅ N := iM.symm ≪≫ (tilde.functor R).mapIso iG ≪≫ iN
    54	  have he : e.hom = φ :=
    55	    calc e.hom
    56	        = iM.inv ≫ ((tilde.functor R).map ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := R)).map φ) ≫
    57	            N.fromTildeΓ) := rfl
    58	      _ = iM.inv ≫ (M.fromTildeΓ ≫ φ) := by rw [key]
    59	      _ = φ := Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc iM φ
    60	  rw [← he]
    61	  exact e.isIso_hom
    62	
    63	-- The functor map and `Hom.app` are definitionally equal only after unfolding a non-reducible
    64	-- functor field.
    65	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
    66	/-- Global-section form of
    67	`Scheme.Modules.isIso_of_isIso_moduleSpecGammaFunctor_map_of_fromTildeGamma`. -/
    68	theorem Scheme.Modules.isIso_of_bijective_appTop_of_fromTildeGamma
    69	    {R : CommRingCat.{u}} {M N : (Spec R).Modules}
    70	    [IsIso M.fromTildeΓ] [IsIso N.fromTildeΓ] (φ : M ⟶ N)
    71	    (h : Function.Bijective (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app φ (⊤ : (Spec R).Opens))) :
    72	    IsIso φ := by
    73	  refine Scheme.Modules.isIso_of_isIso_moduleSpecGammaFunctor_map_of_fromTildeGamma φ ?_
    74	  rw [ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective]
    75	  have hfun : ⇑(ConcreteCategory.hom ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := R)).map φ)) =
    76	      ⇑(ConcreteCategory.hom (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app φ (⊤ : (Spec R).Opens))) := rfl
    77	  rw [hfun]
    78	  exact h
    79	
    80	/-- A morphism of scheme modules is an isomorphism if its section map is an isomorphism on every
    81	affine open.  The proof computes stalks on the affine-open basis, then reflects the resulting
    82	isomorphism of underlying abelian sheaves. -/
    83	theorem Scheme.Modules.isIso_of_isIso_app_affine
    84	    {X : Scheme.{u}} {M N : X.Modules} (φ : M ⟶ N)
    85	    (h : ∀ (U : X.Opens), IsAffineOpen U → IsIso (φ.app U)) :
    86	    IsIso φ := by
    87	  let f := (SheafOfModules.toSheaf.{u} X.ringCatSheaf).map φ
    88	  have happ (U : X.Opens) (hU : U ∈ X.affineOpens) :
    89	      IsIso (f.hom.app (.op U)) := by
    90	    dsimp [f]
    91	    exact h U hU
    92	  have hstalk (x : X) :
    93	      IsIso ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor Ab x).map f.hom) := by
    94	    rw [ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective]
    95	    constructor
    96	    · apply TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_injective_of_isBasis X.isBasis_affineOpens
    97	      intro U hU
    98	      exact (ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective (f.hom.app (.op U))).mp
    99	        (happ U hU) |>.1
   100	    · intro t
   101	      obtain ⟨U, hxU, hU, s, rfl⟩ :=
   102	        TopCat.Presheaf.exists_mem_germ_eq_of_isBasis X.isBasis_affineOpens
   103	          (TopCat.Sheaf.presheaf ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf.{u} X.ringCatSheaf).obj N)) x t
   104	      letI : IsIso (f.hom.app (.op U)) := happ U hU
   105	      refine ⟨(TopCat.Sheaf.presheaf
   106	          ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf.{u} X.ringCatSheaf).obj M)).germ U x hxU
   107	        (inv (f.hom.app (.op U)) s), ?_⟩
   108	      rw [TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_germ_apply]
   109	      simp
   110	  letI (x : X) := hstalk x
   111	  haveI : IsIso f := TopCat.Presheaf.isIso_of_stalkFunctor_map_iso f
   112	  haveI : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf X).map φ) := by
   113	    change IsIso f.hom
   114	    infer_instance
   115	  exact isIso_of_reflects_iso φ (Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf X)
   116	
   117	/-- A morphism of scheme modules is an isomorphism if its restrictions to a family of opens
   118	covering every point are isomorphisms.  The proof transports the restricted stalk maps across
   119	`restrictStalkNatIso`, then reflects the resulting isomorphism of underlying abelian sheaves. -/
   120	theorem Scheme.Modules.isIso_of_isIso_restrict_cover
   121	    {X : Scheme.{u}} {M N : X.Modules} (φ : M ⟶ N)
   122	    {ι : Type*} (U : ι → X.Opens)
   123	    (hcov : ∀ x : X, ∃ i, x ∈ U i)
   124	    (hiso : ∀ i, IsIso ((restrictFunctor (U i).ι).map φ)) :
   125	    IsIso φ := by
   126	  let f := (SheafOfModules.toSheaf.{u} X.ringCatSheaf).map φ
   127	  have hstalk (x : X) :
   128	      IsIso ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor Ab x).map f.hom) := by
   129	    change IsIso ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor Ab x).map ((toPresheaf X).map φ))
   130	    obtain ⟨i, hx⟩ := hcov x
   131	    let xU : (U i).toScheme := ⟨x, hx⟩
   132	    letI hres : IsIso ((restrictFunctor (U i).ι).map φ) := hiso i
   133	    haveI hpres : IsIso ((toPresheaf (U i).toScheme).map
   134	        ((restrictFunctor (U i).ι).map φ)) :=
   135	      Functor.map_isIso _ _
   136	    haveI hr : IsIso ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor Ab xU).map
   137	        ((toPresheaf (U i).toScheme).map ((restrictFunctor (U i).ι).map φ))) :=
   138	      Functor.map_isIso _ _
   139	    let eM := (restrictStalkNatIso (U i).ι xU).app M
   140	    let eN := (restrictStalkNatIso (U i).ι xU).app N
   141	    letI heM : IsIso eM.hom := eM.isIso_hom
   142	    letI heN : IsIso eN.hom := eN.isIso_hom
   143	    have hnat :
   144	        (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor Ab xU).map
   145	              ((toPresheaf (U i).toScheme).map ((restrictFunctor (U i).ι).map φ)) ≫
   146	            eN.hom =
   147	          eM.hom ≫ (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor Ab x).map
   148	            ((toPresheaf X).map φ) := by
   149	      exact (restrictStalkNatIso (U i).ι xU).hom.naturality φ
   150	    haveI hcompLeft : IsIso (
   151	        (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor Ab xU).map
   152	              ((toPresheaf (U i).toScheme).map ((restrictFunctor (U i).ι).map φ)) ≫
   153	            eN.hom) :=
   154	      IsIso.comp_isIso
   155	    haveI hcompRight : IsIso (eM.hom ≫
   156	        (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor Ab x).map ((toPresheaf X).map φ)) := by
   157	      rw [← hnat]
   158	      exact hcompLeft
   159	    exact IsIso.of_isIso_comp_left eM.hom _
   160	  letI (x : X) := hstalk x
   161	  haveI : IsIso f := TopCat.Presheaf.isIso_of_stalkFunctor_map_iso f
   162	  haveI : IsIso ((toPresheaf X).map φ) := by
   163	    change IsIso f.hom
   164	    infer_instance
   165	  exact isIso_of_reflects_iso φ (toPresheaf X)
   166	
   167	/-- Direct consumer for the Beck--Chevalley mate: it is enough to verify its module component on
   168	every affine open of the target scheme `S'`. -/
   169	theorem isIso_canonicalBaseChangeMap_app_of_affine
   170	    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
   171	    {f : X ⟶ S} {g : S' ⟶ S} {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ S'}
   172	    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) (M : X.Modules)
   173	    (h : ∀ (U : S'.Opens), IsAffineOpen U →
   174	      IsIso (((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app M).app U)) :
   175	    IsIso ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app M) := by
   176	  exact Scheme.Modules.isIso_of_isIso_app_affine _ h
   177	
   178	end AlgebraicGeometry

     6	import Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Modules.Tilde
     7	import Mathlib.Algebra.Category.ModuleCat.Sheaf.PullbackFree
     8	
     9	/-!
    10	# Pullback of unit and tilde modules
    11	
    12	This file supplies the unit and affine tensor dictionaries needed by native pushforward base
    13	change.  For every map of schemes, inverse image on opens is final: the top open gives a terminal
    14	object in each structured-arrow category.  Consequently, pullback carries the unit module
    15	canonically to the unit module.
    16	
    17	For a ring map `A \to B`, pullback along `Spec B \to Spec A` takes the tilde sheaf of an
    18	`A`-module to the tilde sheaf of its scalar extension to `B`.
    19	
    20	The proof uses uniqueness of left adjoints.  The only comparison required on the right-adjoint
    21	side is that global sections after pushforward along `Spec.map phi` are restriction of scalars
    22	along `phi`; on underlying sections this is restriction along `top <= (Spec.map phi) ^-1(top)`,
    23	which is the identity.
    24	-/
    25	
    26	set_option autoImplicit false
    27	
    28	universe u
    29	
    30	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite
    31	
    32	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    33	
    34	open Scheme Scheme.Modules
    35	
    36	/-! ## Pullback of the unit module -/
    37	
    38	private noncomputable def opensMapStructuredArrowTerminal {X Y : TopCat.{u}}
    39	    (f : X ⟶ Y) (U : Opens X) :
    40	    IsTerminal (StructuredArrow.mk (Opens.leMapTop f U)) :=
    41	  IsTerminal.ofUniqueHom
    42	    (fun s => StructuredArrow.homMk (Opens.leTop s.right) (Subsingleton.elim _ _))
    43	    (fun _ _ => by
    44	      apply StructuredArrow.hom_ext
    45	      exact Subsingleton.elim _ _)
    46	
    47	@[reducible]
    48	private noncomputable def opensMapFinal {X Y : TopCat.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    49	    (Opens.map f).Final where
    50	  out U := isConnected_of_isTerminal _ (opensMapStructuredArrowTerminal f U)
    51	
    52	/-- Pullback along any morphism of schemes carries the unit module to the unit module by an
    53	isomorphism.  No openness, flatness, or finiteness hypothesis is needed. -/
    54	theorem Scheme.Modules.isIso_pullbackObjUnitToUnit {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    55	    IsIso (SheafOfModules.pullbackObjUnitToUnit f.toRingCatSheafHom) := by
    56	  letI : (Opens.map f.base).Final := opensMapFinal f.base
    57	  infer_instance
    58	
    59	/-- The canonical isomorphism from the pullback of the unit module to the unit module. -/
    60	noncomputable def Scheme.Modules.pullbackUnitIso {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    61	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf) ≅
    62	      SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf :=
    63	  @asIso _ _ _ _ _ (Scheme.Modules.isIso_pullbackObjUnitToUnit f)
    64	
    65	/-! ## Pullback of an affine tilde module -/
    66	
    67	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
    68	private lemma modulesRestrictionPreimageTopEqId {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X)
    69	    (N : Y.Modules) (e : (⊤ : Y.Opens) ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤) :
    70	    N.presheaf.map (homOfLE e).op = 𝟙 _ :=
    71	  (congrArg N.presheaf.map
    72	    (show (homOfLE e).op = 𝟙 (Opposite.op (⊤ : Y.Opens)) from rfl)).trans
    73	    (N.presheaf.map_id _)
    74	
    75	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
    76	private lemma ringRestrictionPreimageTopEqId {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X)
    77	    (e : (⊤ : Y.Opens) ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤) :
    78	    Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE e).op = 𝟙 _ :=
    79	  (congrArg Y.presheaf.map
    80	    (show (homOfLE e).op = 𝟙 (Opposite.op (⊤ : Y.Opens)) from rfl)).trans
    81	    (Y.presheaf.map_id _)
    82	
    83	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
    84	private noncomputable def pullbackTildeGammaBridgeHom {A B : CommRingCat.{u}}
    85	    (phi : A ⟶ B) (N : (Spec B).Modules) :
    86	    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Spec.map phi) ⋙ moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := A)).obj N ⟶
    87	      (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := B) ⋙ ModuleCat.restrictScalars phi.hom).obj N :=
    88	  ConcreteCategory.ofHom
    89	    { toFun := fun x =>
    90	        (N.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top :
    91	          (⊤ : (Spec B).Opens) ≤ Spec.map phi ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤)).op).hom x
    92	      map_add' := fun x y => map_add _ x y
    93	      map_smul' := fun a x =>
    94	        (Scheme.Modules.map_smul N (homOfLE (le_top :
    95	          (⊤ : (Spec B).Opens) ≤ Spec.map phi ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤))
    96	          (((Spec.map phi).app ⊤).hom ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso A).inv.hom a)) x).trans
    97	        (congrArg (fun r => r • (N.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top :
    98	            (⊤ : (Spec B).Opens) ≤ Spec.map phi ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤)).op).hom x)
    99	          ((congrArg (fun (k : Γ(Spec B, Spec.map phi ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤) ⟶ Γ(Spec B, ⊤)) =>
   100	              k.hom (((Spec.map phi).app ⊤).hom ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso A).inv.hom a)))
   101	            (ringRestrictionPreimageTopEqId (Spec.map phi) le_top)).trans
   102	           ((congrArg (fun (psi : A ⟶ Γ(Spec B, ⊤)) => psi.hom a)
   103	              (Scheme.ΓSpecIso_inv_naturality phi)).symm))) }
   104	
   105	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
   106	private lemma pullbackTildeGammaBridgeHom_isIso {A B : CommRingCat.{u}}
   107	    (phi : A ⟶ B) (N : (Spec B).Modules) :
   108	    IsIso (pullbackTildeGammaBridgeHom phi N) := by
   109	  rw [ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective]
   110	  change Function.Bijective (fun x => (N.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top :
   111	    (⊤ : (Spec B).Opens) ≤ Spec.map phi ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤)).op).hom x)
   112	  rw [modulesRestrictionPreimageTopEqId (Spec.map phi) N le_top]
   113	  exact Function.bijective_id
   114	
   115	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
   116	private noncomputable def pullbackTildeGammaBridge {A B : CommRingCat.{u}}
   117	    (phi : A ⟶ B) :
   118	    Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Spec.map phi) ⋙ moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := A) ≅
   119	      moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := B) ⋙ ModuleCat.restrictScalars phi.hom := by
   120	  refine NatIso.ofComponents
   121	    (fun N => @asIso _ _ _ _ _ (pullbackTildeGammaBridgeHom_isIso phi N))
   122	    (fun {N N'} h => ?_)
   123	  ext x
   124	  exact (congrArg (fun (k : Γ(N, Spec.map phi ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤) ⟶ Γ(N', ⊤)) => k.hom x)
   125	    ((Scheme.Modules.Hom.mapPresheaf h).naturality (homOfLE (le_top :
   126	      (⊤ : (Spec B).Opens) ≤ Spec.map phi ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤)).op)).symm
   127	
   128	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
   129	/-- Pullback along `Spec.map phi` carries a tilde module to the tilde of scalar extension.
   130	
   131	This is the affine `pullback of tilde = tilde of tensor product` comparison (Stacks 01HQ).
   132	It is canonical: it is the uniqueness isomorphism between two left adjoints of global sections
   133	with restriction of scalars. -/
   134	noncomputable def Scheme.Modules.pullbackTildeIso {A B : CommRingCat.{u}}
   135	    (phi : A ⟶ B) :
   136	    tilde.functor A ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pullback (Spec.map phi) ≅
   137	      ModuleCat.extendScalars phi.hom ⋙ tilde.functor B :=
   138	  Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq
   139	    (((tilde.adjunction (R := A)).comp
   140	      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (Spec.map phi))).ofNatIsoRight
   141	      (pullbackTildeGammaBridge phi))
   142	    ((ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj phi.hom).comp (tilde.adjunction (R := B)))
   143	
   144	end AlgebraicGeometry

    26	    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X) (N : X.Modules) (V : X.Opens) :

    28	      Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward g).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj N), V) :=

    31	/-- The adjunction-unit base map, restricted from `g ⁻¹ᵁ V` to `U`. -/
    32	noncomputable def pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap
    33	    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X) (N : X.Modules)
    34	    {U : Y.Opens} {V : X.Opens} (e : U ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ V) :
    35	    letI : Algebra Γ(X, V) Γ(Y, U) := (g.appLE V U e).hom.toAlgebra
    36	    letI : Module Γ(X, V) Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj N, U) :=
    37	      Module.compHom _ (g.appLE V U e).hom
    38	    Γ(N, V) →ₗ[Γ(X, V)] Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj N, U) := by
    39	  letI : Algebra Γ(X, V) Γ(Y, U) := (g.appLE V U e).hom.toAlgebra
    40	  letI : Module Γ(X, V) Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj N, U) :=
    41	    Module.compHom _ (g.appLE V U e).hom
    42	  let restr := (((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj N).presheaf.map (homOfLE e).op).hom
    43	  let unit := pullback_app_isoTensor_unitAtV g N V
    44	  refine
    45	    { toFun := fun x => restr (unit x)
    46	      map_add' := ?_
    47	      map_smul' := ?_ }
    48	  · intro x y
    49	    change restr (unit (x + y)) = restr (unit x) + restr (unit y)
    50	    rw [unit.map_add]
    51	    exact restr.map_add _ _
    52	  · intro r x
    53	    change restr (unit (r • x)) = (g.appLE V U e).hom r • restr (unit x)
    54	    rw [unit.map_smul]
    55	    exact ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj N).map_smul (homOfLE e) _ _

   103	-- Expanding the composed adjunction unit traverses nested pullback transports.
   104	private lemma pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap_comp
   105	    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (N : Z.Modules)
   106	    {T : X.Opens} {V : Y.Opens} {U : Z.Opens}
   107	    (eV : V ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ U) (eT : T ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V) (eTU : T ≤ (f ≫ g) ⁻¹ᵁ U) (x : Γ(N, U)) :
   108	    (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f g).hom.app N) T).hom
   109	        (pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap f ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj N) eT
   110	          (pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap g N eV x)) =
   111	      pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap (f ≫ g) N eTU x := by
   112	  have hs1 := congrArg
   113	    (fun (k : Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj N, g ⁻¹ᵁ U) ⟶
   114	        Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj
   115	          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj N)), V)) =>
   116	      (AddCommGrpCat.Hom.hom k)
   117	        (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app N).app U x))
   118	    ((Scheme.Modules.Hom.mapPresheaf
   119	      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app
   120	        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj N))).naturality (homOfLE eV).op)
   121	  have hconj := Scheme.Modules.conjugateEquiv_pullbackComp_inv f g
   122	  have hunit := unit_conjugateEquiv
   123	    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).comp
   124	      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f))
   125	    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (f ≫ g))
   126	    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f g).inv) N
   127	  rw [hconj] at hunit
   128	  have hs2 := congrArg
   129	    (fun (k : N ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (f ≫ g)).obj
   130	        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj N))) =>
   131	      (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app k U).hom x) hunit
   132	  have hs3 := congrArg
   133	    (fun (k : Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (f ≫ g)).obj N, (f ≫ g) ⁻¹ᵁ U) ⟶
   134	        Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj N), T)) =>
   135	      (AddCommGrpCat.Hom.hom k)
   136	        (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (f ≫ g)).unit.app N).app U x))
   137	    ((Scheme.Modules.Hom.mapPresheaf
   138	      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f g).inv.app N)).naturality (homOfLE eTU).op)
   139	  have hs4 : ∀ (z : Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (f ≫ g)).obj N, T)),
   140	      (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f g).hom.app N) T).hom
   141	        ((Scheme.Modules.Hom.app ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f g).inv.app N) T).hom z) =
   142	        z := fun z => congrArg
   143	    (fun (k : (Scheme.Modules.pullback (f ≫ g)).obj N ⟶
   144	        (Scheme.Modules.pullback (f ≫ g)).obj N) =>
   145	      (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app k T).hom z)
   146	    (Iso.inv_hom_id_app (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f g) N)
   147	  refine (congrArg (fun w =>
   148	    (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f g).hom.app N) T).hom
   149	      ((((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj N)).presheaf.map
   150	        (homOfLE eT).op).hom w)) hs1).trans ?_
   151	  refine (congrArg (fun w =>
   152	    (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f g).hom.app N) T).hom w)
   153	    (modules_res_res ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj N))
   154	      eT ((fun _ ha => eV ha) : f ⁻¹ᵁ V ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ (g ⁻¹ᵁ U))
   155	      eTU (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app
   156	          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj N)).app (g ⁻¹ᵁ U)
   157	        (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app N).app U x)))).trans ?_
   158	  refine (congrArg (fun w =>
   159	    (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f g).hom.app N) T).hom
   160	      ((((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj N)).presheaf.map
   161	        (homOfLE eTU).op).hom w)) hs2).trans ?_
   162	  refine (congrArg (fun w =>
   163	    (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f g).hom.app N) T).hom w)
   164	    hs3.symm).trans ?_

   171	    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X) (N : X.Modules) (V : X.Opens) (x : Γ(N, V)) :

   186	/-- The canonical base-change mate sends the unit base-map image along `g`

   188	theorem canonicalBaseChangeMap_app_baseMap_compat

   191	    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)

   193	    (e : U ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ V) (e' : f' ⁻¹ᵁ U ≤ g' ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V))
   194	    (x : Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F, V)) :
   195	    (((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app F).app U).hom
   196	        (pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap g ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F) e x) =
   197	      pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap g' F e' x := by
   198	  have e₂ : f' ⁻¹ᵁ U ≤ (f' ≫ g) ⁻¹ᵁ V := by
   199	    rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage]
   200	    exact fun a ha => e ha
   201	  have e₃ : f' ⁻¹ᵁ U ≤ (g' ≫ f) ⁻¹ᵁ V := by
   202	    rw [sq.w, Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage]
   203	    exact fun a ha => e ha
   204	  have h1 := pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap_le_refl f'
   205	    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F)) U
   206	    (pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap g ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F) e x)
   207	  have h2 := pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap_comp f' g
   208	    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F) e (le_refl (f' ⁻¹ᵁ U)) e₂ x

   211	  have h4' := pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap_comp g' f
   212	    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F) (le_refl (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)) e' e₃ x

   214	        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F)),

   217	          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F)) (f' ⁻¹ᵁ U)).hom

   219	          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F)) (f' ⁻¹ᵁ U)).hom z) = z :=
   220	    fun z => congrArg

   222	          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F) ⟶
   223	          (Scheme.Modules.pullback f ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj
   224	          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F)) =>
   225	        (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app k (f' ⁻¹ᵁ U)).hom z)

   239	    (fun (k : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F ⟶
   240	        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F) =>

   244	      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).counit.app F) (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)).hom

    33	/-!
    34	# Native pullback comparison
    35	
    36	The datum-level `sectionsMap` is already linear over the structure-sheaf map and
    37	commutes with restriction.  It therefore gives a morphism from the native module
    38	to the pushforward of the base-changed native module.  Its adjoint is the
    39	canonical comparison from the geometric pullback of `D.nativeModule` to the
    40	native module rebuilt from `D.baseChange B'`.
    41	-/
    42	
    43	/-- `sectionsMap`, assembled as an `O_{C_B}`-linear map into pushforward. -/
    44	noncomputable def nativeModuleSectionsMap :
    45	    D.nativeModule ⟶
    46	      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (relCurveMap C B B')).obj
    47	        (D.baseChange B').nativeModule :=
    48	  ⟨PresheafOfModules.homMk
    49	    { app := fun U ↦ AddCommGrpCat.ofHom <| AddMonoidHom.mk'
    50	        (fun s ↦ D.sectionsMap B' le_rfl s)
    51	        (fun s t ↦ D.sectionsMap_add B' le_rfl s t)
    52	      naturality := fun {U V} i ↦ by
    53	        ext s
    54	        change D.sectionsMap B' le_rfl
    55	            (gluedRes B D.pieces D.unit i.unop.le s) =
    56	          gluedRes B' (D.baseChange B').pieces (D.baseChange B').unit
    57	            (Scheme.Hom.preimage_mono (relCurveMap C B B') i.unop.le)

     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0RankOneLocusNative
     7	
     8	/-!
     9	# The canonical native rank-one presentation contract
    10	
    11	`PicRankOneLocalPresentation` deliberately leaves the geometric producer fields explicit.
    12	This file fixes the module part of that contract: for a tied cocycle datum `D`, the module is
    13	always `D.nativeModule` and its base-ring comparison is always
    14	`D.nativeModuleKSheafIso`.  The native piece trivializations supply the line-bundle field;
    15	arbitrary-cartesian pushforward base change and the cohomology/rank certificates stay as
    16	explicit obligations.
    17	
    18	The resulting contract is therefore an adapter interface for a future producer, rather than a
    19	second choice of a line bundle.  Its conversion is consumed directly by the public
    20	`PicRankOneOpen` membership theorem below; no unrelated module or untied class can enter
    21	through this bridge, and the adapter itself does not provide the geometric certificates.
    22	-/
    23	
    24	set_option autoImplicit false
    25	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    26	
    27	universe u
    28	
    29	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite MonoidalCategory
    30	  CartesianMonoidalCategory
    31	
    32	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    33	
    34	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    35	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver
    36	
    37	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    38	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    39	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    40	variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    41	variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    42	
    43	/-! ## The native adapter contract -/
    44	
    45	/--
    46	A lambda-tied rank-one presentation whose module is canonically the native module of its
    47	cocycle datum.
    48	
    49	The fields after `datum_class` are exactly the remaining producer obligations.  The line-bundle
    50	certificate is derived from the canonical piece trivializations, so a field-level H⁰/H¹
    51	calculation or an unrelated line bundle cannot be silently substituted for the native
    52	evaluation module.
    53	-/
    54	structure PicRankOneNativePresentation
    55	    (lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)) : Type (u + 1) where
    56	  cover : Algebra.EtaleCover A
    57	  representative : descentClasses C cover
    58	  represents :
    59	    PicEtAff.mk C cover representative = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1
    60	  datum : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C cover.Carrier pi
    61	  datum_class :
    62	    (representative : relPic C (overSpec k cover.Carrier)) =
    63	      relPicMk C (overSpec k cover.Carrier) datum.cechPicClass
    64	  native_pushforward_base_change :
    65	    ∀ {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
    66	      (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
    67	      (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C cover.Carrier)
    68	      (sq : IsPullback g' f'
    69	        (relCurve C cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of cover.Carrier)) g),
    70	      IsIso ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app datum.nativeModule)
    71	  h1_vanishing : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 1)
    72	  h0_finite : Module.Finite cover.Carrier (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0)
    73	  h0_projective : Module.Projective cover.Carrier (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0)
    74	  h0_rank_one :
    75	    ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum cover.Carrier,
    76	      Module.rankAtStalk (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0) p = 1
    77	
    78	namespace PicRankOneNativePresentation
    79	
    80	variable {pi} {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
    81	
    82	/-- Convert the native adapter contract to the existing local-presentation contract.
    83	
    84	The two native bridge fields are inserted definitionally; all other fields are transported
    85	without weakening or adding hypotheses.
    86	-/
    87	noncomputable def toLocalPresentation
    88	    (P : PicRankOneNativePresentation pi lam) :
    89	    PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam :=
    90	  { cover := P.cover
    91	    representative := P.representative
    92	    represents := P.represents
    93	    datum := P.datum
    94	    datum_class := P.datum_class
    95	    module := P.datum.nativeModule
    96	    module_iso := P.datum.nativeModuleKSheafIso
    97	    line_bundle := P.datum.nativeModule_isLineBundle
    98	    native_pushforward_base_change := P.native_pushforward_base_change
    99	    h1_vanishing := P.h1_vanishing
   100	    h0_finite := P.h0_finite
   101	    h0_projective := P.h0_projective
   102	    h0_rank_one := P.h0_rank_one }
   103	
   104	theorem nonempty_localPresentation
   105	    (P : PicRankOneNativePresentation pi lam) :
   106	    Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) :=
   107	  ⟨P.toLocalPresentation⟩
   108	
   109	end PicRankOneNativePresentation
   110	
   111	/-! ## Immediate rank-one-locus consumer -/
   112	
   113	/--
   114	An arbitrary-affine family of native contracts supplies the existing public rank-one-locus
   115	consumer.  The family is quantified in exactly the same way as
   116	`PicRankOneOpen.LocalPresentationCondition`; the conversion only canonicalizes the module
   117	choice and does not manufacture any of the remaining geometric certificates.
   118	-/
   119	theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_of_nativePresentations
   120	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   121	    {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
   122	    (h : ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
   123	        (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
   124	        Nonempty (PicRankOneNativePresentation pi
   125	          ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))) :
   126	    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T := by
   127	  apply mem_picRankOneOpen_of_localPresentations pi
   128	  intro A _ _ t
   129	  obtain ⟨P⟩ := h A t
   130	  exact P.nonempty_localPresentation
   131	
   132	end AlgebraicGeometry

    10	/-!
    11	# Lambda-tied assembly of rank-one family certificates
    12	
    13	This file is the Picard-side consumer of `RankOneFamilyCertificates`.  It does not choose a
    14	module: the certificate and the native presentation are both attached to the displayed cocycle
    15	datum.  The cover representative and its equality with the displayed lambda class provide the
    16	Picard tie, while arbitrary-cartesian native pushforward base change remains a separate geometric
    17	input.
    18	-/
    19	
    20	set_option autoImplicit false
    21	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    22	
    23	universe u
    24	
    25	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite MonoidalCategory
    26	  CartesianMonoidalCategory
    27	
    28	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    29	
    30	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    31	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver
    32	
    33	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    34	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    35	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    36	variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    37	variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    38	
    39	namespace PicRankOneNativePresentation
    40	
    41	variable {pi} {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
    42	
    43	/-! ## The literal native consumer -/
    44	
    45	/-- Assemble the native presentation from certificates for the same displayed cocycle datum.
    46	
    47	The equalities `hrep` and `hclass` tie the datum to the requested lambda class.  All four
    48	cohomological fields are projected from `cert`, whose modules are definitionally the H-modules
    49	of `D.sheaf`; no unrelated or pre-certified target module can enter.  The all-cartesian native
    50	pushforward comparison is intentionally an explicit argument until its protected producer lands.
    51	-/
    52	noncomputable def ofCertificates
    53	    (E : Algebra.EtaleCover A)
    54	    (x : descentClasses C E)
    55	    (hrep : PicEtAff.mk C E x = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1)
    56	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C E.Carrier pi)
    57	    (hclass :
    58	      (x : relPic C (overSpec k E.Carrier)) =
    59	        relPicMk C (overSpec k E.Carrier) D.cechPicClass)
    60	    (hpush :
    61	      ∀ {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
    62	        (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of E.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
    63	        (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C E.Carrier)
    64	        (sq : IsPullback g' f'
    65	          (relCurve C E.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of E.Carrier)) g),
    66	        IsIso ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app D.nativeModule))
    67	    (cert : RankOneFamilyCertificates D) :
    68	    PicRankOneNativePresentation pi lam :=
    69	  { cover := E
    70	    representative := x
    71	    represents := hrep
    72	    datum := D
    73	    datum_class := hclass
    74	    native_pushforward_base_change := hpush
    75	    h1_vanishing := cert.h1_vanishing
    76	    h0_finite := cert.h0_finite
    77	    h0_projective := cert.h0_projective
    78	    h0_rank_one := cert.h0_rank_one }
    79	
    80	end PicRankOneNativePresentation
    81	
    82	end AlgebraicGeometry

   261	/-- **Base change of the pinned cocycle datum** along `B → B'` (stage (1d-ii), the
   262	datum half; the RE-5 descent/transport interface): generators, partition coefficients
   263	and transition units push forward through the relative-curve comparison; the cocycle
   264	identities are carried by ring-hom functoriality (`Scheme.Hom.appLE_resHom`). -/

   266	  toBasicOpenCoverData := D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B'
   267	  unit i j := Units.map (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.overlapMap B' i j).toMonoidHom
   268	    (D.unit i j)
   269	  isGluingCocycle := by
   270	    constructor
   271	    · intro i
   272	      have h := D.isGluingCocycle.unit_self i
   273	      change (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.overlapMap B' i i)
   274	        ((D.unit i i : Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces i))) = 1
   275	      rw [h, map_one]
   276	    · intro i j l
   277	      -- the triple overlap of the base-changed pieces sits below the preimage of the
   278	      -- triple overlap
   279	      have htriple : (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces i ⊓
   280	            (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces j ⊓
   281	            (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces l ≤
   282	          relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ (D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j ⊓ D.pieces l) := by
   283	        rw [Scheme.Hom.preimage_inf]
   284	        exact inf_le_inf (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange_inf_le_preimage B' i j)
   285	          (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange_pieces_le_preimage B' l)
   286	      have key := congrArg
   287	        (((relCurveMap C B B').appLE (D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j ⊓ D.pieces l)
   288	          ((D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces i ⊓
   289	            (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces j ⊓
   290	            (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces l) htriple).hom)
   291	        (D.isGluingCocycle.mul_res i j l)
   292	      rw [map_mul] at key
   293	      have e₁ := (relCurveMap C B B').appLE_resHom
   294	        (inf_le_left : D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j ⊓ D.pieces l ≤ D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)
   295	        (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange_inf_le_preimage B' i j) htriple
   296	        (inf_le_left : (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces i ⊓
   297	          (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces j ⊓
   298	          (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces l ≤
   299	          (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces i ⊓
   300	            (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces j)
   301	        ((D.unit i j : Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)))
   302	      have e₂ := (relCurveMap C B B').appLE_resHom
   303	        (gluedInclCoc D.pieces (D.pieces i) j l)
   304	        (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange_inf_le_preimage B' j l) htriple
   305	        (gluedInclCoc (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces
   306	          ((D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces i) j l)
   307	        ((D.unit j l : Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces j ⊓ D.pieces l)))
   308	      have e₃ := (relCurveMap C B B').appLE_resHom

   310	        (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange_inf_le_preimage B' i l) htriple
   311	        (gluedInclSnd (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces
   312	          ((D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces i) j l)
   313	        ((D.unit i l : Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces l)))
   314	      rw [← e₁, ← e₂, ← e₃] at key

   341	the relative-curve comparison to every component. Matching is carried by
   342	`Scheme.Hom.appLE_resHom` and the base-changed units. -/
   343	noncomputable def sectionsMap (hW' : W' ≤ relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ W)
   344	    (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit W)) :
   345	    ↥(gluedSubmodule B' (D.baseChange B').pieces (D.baseChange B').unit W') := by
   346	  refine ⟨fun j => ((relCurveMap C B B').appLE (W ⊓ D.pieces j)
   347	    (W' ⊓ (D.baseChange B').pieces j) (D.sectionsMap_component_le B' hW' j)).hom
   348	    (s.val j), ?_⟩
   349	  intro i j
   350	  have hdouble : W' ⊓ (D.baseChange B').pieces i ⊓ (D.baseChange B').pieces j ≤
   351	      relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ (W ⊓ D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j) := by
   352	    rw [Scheme.Hom.preimage_inf]
   353	    exact inf_le_inf (D.sectionsMap_component_le B' hW' i)
   354	      (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange_pieces_le_preimage B' j)
   355	  have key := congrArg
   356	    (((relCurveMap C B B').appLE (W ⊓ D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)
   357	      (W' ⊓ (D.baseChange B').pieces i ⊓ (D.baseChange B').pieces j) hdouble).hom)
   358	    ((mem_gluedSubmodule_iff B D.pieces D.unit
   359	      (s.val : ∀ l : D.index, Γ(relCurve C B, W ⊓ D.pieces l))).mp s.property i j)
   360	  rw [map_mul] at key
   361	  have e₁ := (relCurveMap C B B').appLE_resHom
   362	    (inf_le_left : W ⊓ D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j ≤ W ⊓ D.pieces i)
   363	    (D.sectionsMap_component_le B' hW' i) hdouble
   364	    (inf_le_left : W' ⊓ (D.baseChange B').pieces i ⊓ (D.baseChange B').pieces j ≤
   365	      W' ⊓ (D.baseChange B').pieces i) (s.val i)
   366	  have e₂ := (relCurveMap C B B').appLE_resHom
   367	    (gluedInclCoc D.pieces W i j)
   368	    (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange_inf_le_preimage B' i j) hdouble
   369	    (gluedInclCoc (D.baseChange B').pieces W' i j)
   370	    ((D.unit i j : Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)))
   371	  have e₃ := (relCurveMap C B B').appLE_resHom
   372	    (gluedInclSnd D.pieces W i j)
   373	    (D.sectionsMap_component_le B' hW' j) hdouble
   374	    (gluedInclSnd (D.baseChange B').pieces W' i j) (s.val j)
   375	  rw [← e₁, ← e₂, ← e₃] at key
   376	  exact key
